description: A file that declares no test and has an error: whether the file got as far as a result decides which text Jest prints. A throw while the file loads is the file's own error (the runner's onFailure path). An error circus files under unhandledErrors during the run (a describe, or the file, that holds a hook and no test: "Invalid: beforeEach() may not be used in a describe block containing no tests.") lands in testExecError beside an empty testResults, and the scheduler's onResult tests only testResults.length === 0, so the file prints "Your test suite must contain at least one test." and the error is not shown. One Jest worker, the default reporter and --json.

run.keepLines: ^(PASS|FAIL|SKIP) |^Test Suites:|^Tests:|must contain|thrown while loading|may not be used
